description: This file contains utility functions for calculating costs related to Explainable AI (XAI) models, including token billing and web search request costs. It leverages a generic cost calculator and adds XAI-specific logic for reasoning tokens and web source costs.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Type annotation for usage data, holds token counts and details.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: Model information details, used in cost calculations.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token(model: str, usage: Usage)
methods.description: Calculates prompt and completion costs for an XAI model, adjusting for reasoning tokens.

methods.name: float cost_per_web_search_request(usage: "Usage", model_info: "ModelInfo")
methods.description: Calculates the cost of web search requests based on the number of sources used.
